evd_title: AI Scientist achieved accuracy 0.47 F1 0.44 kappa 0.05 on same novelty evaluation test set
finding: AI Scientist achieved accuracy 0.47 F1 0.44 kappa 0.05 on same novelty evaluation test set
P: 32-idea held-out test set of scientific ideas (CS/NLP; Scideator + ICLR/NeurIPS), expert binary novelty labels
I: AI Scientist (Lu et al.) novelty prompt, few-shot, given idea + fixed top-10 retrieved papers (prompt-only swap)
C: Expert labels (2 authors); Idea Novelty Checker gpt-4o (kappa 0.59); AI Researcher gpt-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet
O: AI Scientist: Acc 0.47, F1 0.44, kappa 0.05; vs INC F1 0.79/kappa 0.59; AI Researcher gpt-4o F1 0.75/kappa 0.52
S: Comparative few-shot LLM benchmark on expert-annotated test set
T: Ideas from Scideator + ICLR 2022/NeurIPS 2023 OpenReview; gpt-4o run Aug-Sep 2024; paper 2025
